approved.en: Israeli airstrikes in Gaza have killed a senior Hamas commander and six people, including a doctor and a child, at Nasser Hospital, while mass funerals are held for the fallen. Heavy rains have flooded tens of thousands of tents, causing a baby to die from cold. In the West West Bank, Israeli settlers attacked Palestinians, wounding several, and Israeli troops occupied the home of a Palestinian-American. Kosovo fans booed the Israeli anthem before a Nations League draw, and the European Union called for unimpeded humanitarian aid to Gaza. The United Nations reported 21,440 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Kraftig regn har oversvømt titusenvis av telt, og et spedbarn døde av kulde. På Vestbredden angrep israelske bosettere palestinere og såret flere, og israelske soldater okkuperte hjemmet til en palestinsk-amerikansk. Kosovofans jublet for den israelske nasjonalsangen før en Nations-League-kamp endte uavgjort, og EU oppfordret til uhindret humanitær hjelp til Gaza. FN rapporterte 21 440 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

The Lebanese army seized a large weapons cache in a Beirut suburb warehouse and another depot in the city’s southern suburbs. Hezbollah arrested five members in Batroun, continued artillery fire on Israeli positions and began cash payments to war victims and displaced families. UNRWA funding cuts have deepened hardship for Palestinian refugees in Lebanon. The conflict has caused 4,335 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

approved.en: Iran has launched a second drone attack on Bahrain within three days, striking a U.S. military radar and a building in Tel Aviv with a missile, while Bahrain intercepted additional Iranian drones. The United States responded by striking Iran's Qeshm Island and disabling a commercial vessel in the Gulf of Oman. Iran also opened a women’s war-readiness training camp and designated the Argentine navy and air force as terrorist organisations, warning of retaliation against European bases hosting U.S. forces. Qatar reported progress in U.S., Iran talks after a White House meeting. 123 battle-related deaths were recorded in 2024, according to UCDP.

USA svarte med å angripe Irans Qeshm-øy og deaktivere et kommersielt fartøy i Omanbukta. Iran åpnet også en kvinne-krigberedskapsleir og erklærte den argentinske marinen og luftforsvaret som terrororganisasjoner, og varslet gjengjeldelse mot europeiske baser som huser amerikanske styrker. Qatar rapporterte fremgang i US-Iran-samtaler etter et møte i Det hvite hus. 123 kamprelaterte dødsfall ble registrert i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

Japan's ONE shipping group has transited the Red Sea choke point for the first time in three years, indicating limited commercial movement despite the fighting. Separate car bomb blasts have also killed two people, including a child, in the capital area. Syrian and Lebanese interior ministers are holding special meetings in Damascus to discuss border control and expand security cooperation, while Saudi officials note growing military cooperation with Syria. The conflict caused 2,732 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Separate bilbombeeksplosjoner har også drept to personer, inkludert et barn, i hovedstadsområdet. Syriske og libanesiske innenriksministre holder spesielle møter i Damaskus for å diskutere grensekontroll og utvide sikkerhetssamarbeidet, mens saudiarabiske tjenestemenn påpeker økt militært samarbeid med Syria. Kataib Hezbollah has rejected the findings of an oil probe in Jurf al-Nasr, accused the prime minister of yielding to US and Gulf pressure, and been given an end-of-week deadline by al-Zaidi to vacate the area, while al-Zaidi has threatened force to assert control over Jurf al-Sakhar. Bahrain har anklaget Iran for å angripe sitt territorium som gjengjeldelse for amerikanske handlinger, og knyttet regionale spenninger til den irakiske smuglingsnedturen. 396 kamprelaterte dødsfall ble registrert i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: The Sudanese Armed Forces have captured Al-Khuwai in West Kordofan and are advancing toward Al-Nahud, while the Rapid Support Forces continue to use drones to strike civilian areas in West Kordofan, the Blue Nile, and power stations, plunging cities into darkness. Humanitarian aid is deteriorating, with food assistance cut for 900,000 people and civilians fleeing towns such as Abu Zabad. A suspected chemical weapons storage site was reported at Sudanese army facilities, and the RSF-led government is planning to use the port of Togo for western Sudan trade. 4,680 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Den humanitære hjelpen forverres, med matstøtte kuttet for 900 000 personer og sivile som flykter fra byer som Abu Zabad. Et mistenkt lager for kjemiske våpen ble rapportert ved SAF-anlegg, og RSF-ledet regjering planlegger å bruke Togo-havnen for handel med vestlige Sudan. 4 680 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: South Sudan has again delayed its first post-independence elections, now set for February 2027, as violence escalates in the north-east where opposition forces clash with government troops in Akobo. Amnesty International and the United Nations have been criticised for ignoring warnings before the Abiemnom massacre that killed at least 213 civilians. An ambush on a convoy in Juba killed two people, including a journalist, and a CityLink Aviation plane crashed near Juba, killing all 14 aboard. There were 2 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
approved.nb: Sør-Sudan har igjen utsatt sine første valg etter uavhengigheten, som nå er satt til februar 2027, mens volden eskalerer i nord-øst hvor opposisjonsstyrker kjemper mot regjeringshæren i Akobo. Amnesty International og FN har blitt kritisert for å ha ignorert advarsler før Abiemnom-massakren som drepte minst 213 sivile. Et bakholdsangrep på en konvoi i Juba drepte to personer, inkludert en journalist, og et CityLink Aviation-fly styrtet nær Juba, der alle 14 ombord omkom. Det var 2 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Al-Shabaab continues probe attacks testing Kenya's border defenses while militia forces killed eight Somali civilians near the Kenya-Ethiopia border. Ugandan troops are withdrawing from Somalia, prompting security concerns around Mogadishu, and Uganda denies that its soldiers were killed in the country. Somalia joined 17 nations in condemning an Israeli strike on a Gaza hospital and a Somali refugee woman was killed by Houthi shelling of a camp in Lahj. Rainstorms in Lower Shabelle killed a mother and two children, and protests erupted in Hirshabelle over the regional election as al-Shabaab seized Coomaad. The conflict produced 2,284 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Ugandiske tropper trekker seg tilbake fra Somalia, noe som gir sikkerhetsbekymringer rundt Mogadishu, og Uganda benekter at deres soldater ble drept i landet. Somalia sluttet seg til 17 nasjoner i å fordømme et israelsk angrep på et sykehus i Gaza, og en somalisk flyktningkvinne ble drept av houthiene som skjøt missiler mot en leir i Lahj. Regnstormer i Lower Shabelle drepte en mor og to barn, og protester brøt ut i Hirshabelle over det regionale valget da al-Shabaab tok kontroll over Coomaad. Konflikten førte til 2 284 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: President Biya has finally announced a date for the long-delayed national elections, ending his prolonged absence from public view. Two Cameroonians serving in Russia’s army were reported killed, prompting the African Bar Association to call for mediation in the Anglophone crisis.
